$comment: Central registry of all written-text corpus sources across the Sauti Labs platform. Each entry must conform to frameworks/corpus-registry/schema/corpus-source.schema.json. Tracks provenance and copyright status distinct from dataset-framework's processed dataset registry.

sources.title: Muma Manyien - Dholuo Bible Translation
sources.license_details: Publisher and permission terms not yet formally verified by Sauti Labs; must be confirmed directly with the Bible Society of Kenya before use in any dataset.
sources.notes: Identified as a candidate source due to high translation quality and full-text coverage in Dholuo, a severely under-resourced language. Status intentionally set to 'unknown_pending_review' and copyright_status left unresolved per corpus-registry's Copyright Discipline rule — must not be used to derive any dataset until formally cleared.

sources.title: African Storybook Project - Dholuo Story Collection
sources.author_or_publisher: Saide (South African Institute for Distance Education) - African Storybook Initiative
sources.license_details: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) or CC BY-NC, applied per individual storybook. Openly licensed for use, distribution, and adaptation without requiring permission, provided attribution is given to authors, illustrators, translators, and the African Storybook initiative as publisher. Verified via africanstorybook.org and Creative Commons 'State of the Commons' feature (2017).
sources.notes: Confirmed via web search (2026-07-11) that the African Storybook Project publishes openly licensed children's storybooks in Dholuo among 236+ African languages. Each individual storybook's specific CC license variant (BY vs BY-NC) must be confirmed per-story before dataset derivation, since license terms are set per title rather than uniformly across the whole collection.
